story.title: Ethereum Co-Founder Joseph Lubin Predicts the Merger of AI and Crypto. Here's the Most Likely Scenario for Ethereum. - Yahoo Finance

facts.text: 7, Ethereum (CRYPTO: ETH) co-founder Joseph Lubin said on CNBC that while AI might offer creativity and expertise, it can't create trust, which blockchains like his can help to supply.
In his view, AI and crypto will thus end up merging, becoming the system where programmatic work can be commissioned, completed, and compensated.
The most likely scenario is that Ethereum's capital pulls agents in gradually, with payments flowing through its Layer-2 networks.
There's a little bit of evidence that Lubin's world is already starting to peek into existence.
Here's what it'd mean for Ethereum if that continues.
Today, one of Ethereum's biggest contributions to the AI-in-crypto segment is ERC-8004, a new standard for blockchains that calls for tracking the identities and reputations of AI agents.
Yahoo Finance is not a broker-dealer or investment adviser and does not offer securities or cryptocurrencies for sale or facilitate trading.
Still, there are signs Lubin's vision is taking shape.
Ethereum hosted about 32,343 registered agents as of May 13 of this year, so its count has more than doubled in five months.
It also holds the most capital, which agents will likely need to use, with $49.6 billion in capital stored in its decentralized finance (DeFi) apps, and more than $144 billion in stablecoins.
That makes Ethereum a practical way to add AI exposure to a well-balanced crypto portfolio , even if agent-driven fees take years to ramp up, which they might.
Monthly agent payments over x402, a standard for paying in stablecoins, peaked at $20.5 million in November 2025, and then fell to $263,863 in September 2026.
Meanwhile, Ethereum collected $17.7 million in transaction fees in the 30 days ending on Oct.
Agents supplied almost none of that, since Ethereum's main chain had settled just 644 agent payments as of Oct.
Watch two numbers: Ethereum's share of registered agents, and monthly x402 payments.

If agents are making payments on Ethereum and doing most of their business there, it'll be bullish for the coin even if the trust element that Lubin is hoping for never becomes as important as he expects.

The 10 stocks that made the cut could produce monster returns in the coming years.
